story.soThat: I can capture tutorials and demonstrations
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create recordingStore for state management - Task 2: Implement unified get-sources IPC channel - Task 3: Create RecordingModal component - Task 4: Create SourceSelector component for screen sources - Task 5: Implement preview before recording - Task 6: Create AudioSourceSelector component - Task 7: Add Record button to sidebar - Task 8: Implement countdown before recording starts - Task 9: Implement screen recording capture - Task 10: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 11: Create RecordingService in main process - Task 12: Implement recording-tick IPC event - Task 13: NFR Validation - Security and Performance - Task 14: Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. "Record" button visible in left sidebar 2. Clicking Record opens recording setup modal 3. User can select recording mode: "Screen Only" 4. User can choose full screen or specific window/application 5. Preview shows what will be recorded before starting 6. Audio source selection (microphone, system audio, both, or none) 7. "Start Recording" button initiates countdown (3-2-1) then begins capture

docs.doc: RecordingState interface with selectedScreen/selectedWebcam as string IDs only (not full objects). Source interface with id, name, type, thumbnail. Unified get-sources IPC returns both screens and webcams. start-recording IPC accepts RecordingConfig.

User clicks Record → modal opens → select mode → get-sources IPC → display sources with thumbnails → select source (store ID only) → preview via getUserMedia → countdown (3-2-1) → MediaRecorder starts → recording-tick events update duration.
Main process handles source enumeration via desktopCapturer. Renderer process handles MediaRecorder capture (requires DOM context). IPC bridge for communication.

native.api: Screen capture stream from desktopCapturer source (renderer)

story-context.constraints: - Recording state managed in Zustand recordingStore - Source IDs stored as strings, NOT full Source objects - Unified get-sources IPC returns {screens: Source[], webcams: Source[]} - Main process handles desktopCapturer enumeration (security) - Renderer process handles MediaRecorder capture (requires DOM) - RecordingModal uses shadcn/ui Dialog component - Countdown: 3-2-1 display before recording starts - recording-tick IPC event every second updates duration - Temp directory: os.tmpdir()/chop-shop/recordings/ - Filename: screen-recording-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss.webm

interfaces.interface: Payload: { duration: number } // Elapsed seconds Emitted every second during recording

tests.standards: Jest for unit testing recordingStore. Manual integration testing for IPC channels, MediaRecorder capture, permissions flow. Performance: source enumeration < 500ms.
tests.locations: src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/ Manual testing: recording modal, source selection, permissions, actual screen recording
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify Record button visible in sidebar with red accent - AC2: Manual test clicking Record opens modal - AC3: Manual verify "Screen Only" mode tab exists - AC4: Manual test get-sources IPC returns screens, select source stores ID only - AC5: Manual test preview shows selected screen before recording - AC6: Manual test microphone selection (system audio disabled on macOS) - AC7: Manual test countdown (3-2-1) then MediaRecorder starts - Unit test recordingStore state transitions (idle → recording) - Integration test: permission denied shows error with instructions - Edge case: No sources available disables recording
